description: Ministry of Defence - The award of the Armed Services, Long Service Medal and Clasp to the Air force Personnel
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of long service medals and clasps to armed services personnel based on years of service completion. This falls under public service matters as it deals with service recognition, awards, and benefits for military personnel, which is a subset of public sector administration. The content does not involve government structural changes, specific portfolio assignments, or personnel appointments with responsibilities, but rather recognizes service milestones in the armed forces.
